guitar.evidence: Rivers Cuomo, Weezer's frontman/guitarist, is documented playing Gibson Les Pauls and other guitars on the Blue Album era (which includes "Undone - The Sweater Song").

tone.target: bright jangle-pop clean/crunch with slight chorus
tone.profile: bright jangle-pop clean/crunch with slight chorus
tone.summary: A bright, clean foundation using a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) with light compression and chorus for jangly pop tones.
corrections: favor jangly clean over crunchy rock

rig.name: Weezer-Undone - The Sweater Song - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Simulate the Tube Screamer boost for adding mid-range punch and gentle overdrive.
blocks.gap: The GP-180 lacks a dedicated TS model, so 'Boost' is used to simulate the mid-hump effect while keeping gain low.
No dedicated dirt module is needed as the 'Boost' pedal handles the required gentle crunch. Keeping this slot empty or bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Provide the bright, clean, Fender-style foundation required for jangle pop.
Simulate the small, bright cabinet suggested by the 'Fender-style' clue.
Bypass (Wah is not required for this genre).
Add the required light chorus effect for leads and verses.
Add subtle depth and space to the clean signal.
Provide a natural, non-muddy ambience to complement the bright tone.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and clarity.

proposals.reason: Improve the natural, bright sound of a small combo amp.
